//: The presets (@beaconsgg/tsconfig, @beaconsgg/vitest-config) are registry packages here, so a changed compiler flag or coverage floor arrives as a lockfile change, which is in every task's default inputs. The server suite and the five-flow driver's (which boots the server) declare their database variable: turbo 2 runs tasks with a filtered environment, so an undeclared variable is stripped rather than mis-hashed, and declaring it also stops a pre-database cached run replaying as a hit. agentGuidance off: turbo would otherwise write an AGENTS.md at the root on every run from an AI agent, which is not a file of this repo.
